evaluated_model_form: Trained wide video weights with fixed binary masks; physical compact export follows selection.

execution_provenance.limitation: Node 2 RTX PRO 6000 / PyTorch 2.11 outputs are reused alongside new node 3 H100 / PyTorch 2.10 outputs. Cross-environment numerical equivalence was not tested, per user instruction.

limitation: Inconclusive paired differences are not proof of equivalence. This is an exploratory recovery candidate; policy retention and recoverability remain unproven.

ranking_rule.fit_data: Used for overfitting and consistency diagnostics, not candidate ranking.
ranking_rule.primary: Lowest held-out task-macro GT action MSE across all 35 tasks, with all four primary suites and DLC separately reported.
ranking_rule.task_regressions: Report every task and components; do not hide them in the aggregate.
ranking_rule.teacher_tiebreak: Consider other candidates only when the paired 95% episode-bootstrap interval of their aggregate GT difference includes zero and no primary suite has a 95% interval wholly above zero versus the GT leader. Among these candidates choose minimum fixed-reliability teacher agreement MSE.
ranking_rule.teacher_weights: Computed only from teacher versus GT and the fixed zero-action baseline/component checks; identical across candidates.
ranking_rule.uncertainty_caveat: A non-significant difference is inconclusive, not proof that candidates are equivalent. Any selected GT/teacher tradeoff must be shown explicitly before recovery.

validation_scope: Held out from current mask fitting; repeatedly used monitoring data, not an untouched final test set.
